sql-service.name: cs.inf050.rec_user.player.log.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT distinct REC.PLAY_DATE DD, REC.PLAY_TIME TT, format(CONVERT(date, REC.PLAY_DATE), 'yyyyMMdd') AS PLAY_DATE ,CASE WHEN REC.LOG_GUBUN='L' THEN '녹취청취' WHEN REC.LOG_GUBUN='S' THEN '녹취내용조회' END AS LOG_GUBUN ,REC.PLAY_TIME ,ORG1_NAME ,ORG2_NAME ,ORG3_NAME ,ORG.USER_NAME+'('+ORG.USER_ID+')' USER_NAME ,(SELECT TOP(1) UCID_DATE FROM ms_stt_meta A where A.UCID = REC.UCID ORDER BY A.REG_DATE DESC) AS REC_START_TIME ,(SELECT MAX(USER_NAME) FROM ms_stt_meta a, ms_usermaster b where a.UCID = REC.UCID and a.USER_ID=b.USER_ID GROUP BY UCID) AS REC_USER_NAME ,REC.CONTACT_USER_IP ,REC.UCID ,REC.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,(SELECT TOP(1) FILE_FULL_PATH FROM ms_stt_meta A WHERE REC.UCID=A.UCID ORDER BY A.REG_DATE DESC) FILE_PATH FROM ms_player_log REC, (SELECT USER_ID,USER_NAME,ORG1_CD, ORG1_NAME, ORG2_CD, ORG2_NAME, ORG3_CD,ORG3_NAME FROM vw_usermaster vw WHERE 1=1 ?user_id ?org1_cd ?org2_flag ?org3_cd ) ORG WHERE 1=1 AND REC.PLAY_USER_ID = ORG.USER_ID AND REC.PLAY_TIME BETWEEN '?stime' AND '?etime' ?play_date ?ucid ?log_gb ORDER BY REC.PLAY_DATE DESC, REC.PLAY_TIME DESC

condition.value: AND VW.ORG2_CD IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SYS002' AND CODE_ID NOT IN ('KB00','00') AND USE_YN = 'Y')

sql-service.name: cs.inf050.play_user.player.log.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT RE.* , UM1.USER_NAME+'('+UM1.USER_ID+')' USER_NAME , (SELECT CD2.DEPT_NAME FROM ms_dept CD2 WHERE CD2.DEPT_CD = CD1.ORG1_CD) AS ORG1_NAME , (SELECT CD2.DEPT_NAME FROM ms_dept CD2 WHERE CD2.DEPT_CD = CD1.ORG2_CD) AS ORG2_NAME , (SELECT CD2.DEPT_NAME FROM ms_dept CD2 WHERE CD2.DEPT_CD = CD1.ORG3_CD) AS ORG3_NAME FROM ( SELECT distinct format(CONVERT(date, REC.PLAY_DATE), 'yyyyMMdd') AS PLAY_DATE ,CASE WHEN REC.LOG_GUBUN='L' THEN '녹취청취' WHEN REC.LOG_GUBUN='S' THEN '녹취내용조회' END AS LOG_GUBUN ,REC.PLAY_TIME ,(SELECT TOP(1) UCID_DATE FROM ms_stt_meta A where A.UCID = REC.UCID ORDER BY A.REG_DATE DESC) AS REC_START_TIME ,ORG.USER_NAME AS REC_USER_NAME ,REC.CONTACT_USER_IP ,REC.UCID ,REC.PLAY_USER_ID ,REC.CON_ENT_DGN_NO CED_NO ,(SELECT TOP(1) FILE_FULL_PATH FROM ms_stt_meta A WHERE REC.UCID=A.UCID ORDER BY A.REG_DATE DESC) FILE_PATH FROM ms_player_log REC, (SELECT UM.USER_ID,UM.USER_NAME FROM ms_usermaster UM, ms_dept CD WHERE UM.DEPT_CD = CD.DEPT_CD ?user_id ?org1_cd ?org2_flag ?org3_cd) ORG WHERE 1=1 AND REC.REC_USER_ID = ORG.USER_ID AND REC.PLAY_TIME BETWEEN '?stime' AND '?etime' ?play_date ?ucid ?log_gb ) RE, ms_dept CD1, ms_usermaster UM1 WHERE RE.PLAY_USER_ID = UM1.USER_ID AND UM1.DEPT_CD = CD1.DEPT_CD ORDER BY RE.PLAY_DATE DESC

condition.value: AND CD.ORG2_CD IN (SELECT CODE_ID FROM MS_CODEBOOK WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'SYS002' AND CODE_ID NOT IN ('KB00','00') AND USE_YN = 'Y')

sql-service.name: wfm.info.inf040.codetype.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY CODE_ID DESC) AS NO ,A.CODE_TYPE ,A.CODE_NAME ,A.CODE_ID ,SUBSTRING(A.CODE_TYPE, 1, 3) AS CODE_GROUP ,A.ETC1 ,A.ETC2 ,A.ETC3 ,A.ETC4 ,A.ETC5 ,A.PARENT_TYPE ,A.PARENT_ID ,A.CENTER_CD ,A.USE_YN ,(SELECT CODE_NAME FROM ms_codebook WHERE CODE_ID IN ('00', 'KB00') AND CODE_TYPE = A.PARENT_TYPE) AS PARENT_NAME ,A.REG_ID ,A.REG_TIME ,(SELECT T.USER_NAME FROM ms_usermaster T WHERE A.CHG_ID = T.USER_ID) AS CHG_ID ,( SUBSTRING(A.CHG_TIME, 1, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(A.CHG_TIME, 5, 2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(A.CHG_TIME, 7, 2) + '-' + SUBSTRING(A.CHG_TIME, 9, 2) + ':' + SUBSTRING(A.CHG_TIME, 11, 2)) AS CHG_TIME FROM ms_codebook A WHERE A.CODE_ID IN ('00', 'KB00') AND ((?p_sch_code_type IS NOT NULL AND '1' = ?p_sch_code_type AND A.CODE_TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%',?p_sch_text,'%') OR ?p_sch_code_type IS NULL) OR (?p_sch_code_type IS NOT NULL AND '2' = ?p_sch_code_type AND A.CODE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',?p_sch_text,'%') OR ?p_sch_code_type IS NULL)) AND ?p_module_type ORDER BY A.CODE_TYPE

sql-service.name: wfm.info.inf040.code.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY T.CODE_ID DESC) AS NO ,T.CODE_ID ,T.CODE_NAME ,T.CODE_TYPE ,T.ETC1 ,T.ETC2 ,T.ETC3 ,T.ETC4 ,T.ETC5 ,T.PARENT_ID ,T.PARENT_TYPE ,T.USE_YN ,T.CENTER_CD ,T.SORT_KEY ,T.REG_ID ,T.REG_TIME ,T.CHG_ID ,T.CHG_TIME FROM ms_codebook T WHERE T.CODE_TYPE = ?p_code_type AND T.CODE_ID NOT IN ('00', 'KB00') AND (?p_use_yn='' OR ?p_use_yn IS NULL OR T.USE_YN = ?p_use_yn) ORDER BY T.CODE_TYPE, CONVERT(INT,T.SORT_KEY),T.CODE_ID

sql-service.name: wfm.info.inf040.parentcode.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT CODE_ID AS CODEID ,CODE_NAME AS CODENAME ,CHG_ID ,CHG_TIME ,CENTER_CD FROM ms_codebook WHERE CODE_TYPE = ?p_parent_type AND ('' IS NOT NULL AND CENTER_CD = '' OR '' IS NULL) AND CODE_ID NOT IN ('00', 'KB00') AND (?p_use_yn IS NOT NULL AND USE_YN = ?use_yn OR ?p_use_yn IS NULL) ORDER BY CODE_TYPE, CODE_ID

sql-service.name: wfm.info.inf040.codebook.ins
sql-service.query: INSERT INTO ms_codebook( CODE_ID ,CODE_NAME ,CODE_TYPE ,ETC1 ,ETC2 ,ETC3 ,ETC4 ,ETC5 ,PARENT_ID ,PARENT_TYPE ,USE_YN ,SORT_KEY ,REG_ID ,REG_TIME ,CHG_ID ,CHG_TIME ) VALUES ( RTRIM(LTRIM(?code_id)) ,RTRIM(LTRIM(?code_name)) ,RTRIM(LTRIM(?code_type)) ,RTRIM(LTRIM(?etc1)) ,RTRIM(LTRIM(?etc2)) ,RTRIM(LTRIM(?etc3)) ,RTRIM(LTRIM(?etc4)) ,RTRIM(LTRIM(?etc5)) ,RTRIM(LTRIM(?parent_id)) ,RTRIM(LTRIM(?parent_type)) ,RTRIM(LTRIM(?use_yn)) ,RTRIM(LTRIM(?sort_key)) ,RTRIM(LTRIM(?reg_id)) ,FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') ,RTRIM(LTRIM(?chg_id)) ,FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') )

sql-service.name: wfm.info.inf040.codebook.upd
sql-service.query: UPDATE ms_codebook SET CODE_NAME = RTRIM(LTRIM(?code_name)) ,ETC1 = RTRIM(LTRIM(?etc1)) ,ETC2 = RTRIM(LTRIM(?etc2)) ,ETC3 = RTRIM(LTRIM(?etc3)) ,ETC4 = RTRIM(LTRIM(?etc4)) ,ETC5 = RTRIM(LTRIM(?etc5)) ,PARENT_ID = RTRIM(LTRIM(?parent_id)) ,PARENT_TYPE = RTRIM(LTRIM(?parent_type)) ,USE_YN = RTRIM(LTRIM(?use_yn)) ,SORT_KEY = RTRIM(LTRIM(?sort_key)) ,CHG_ID = RTRIM(LTRIM(?chg_id)) ,CHG_TIME = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') WHERE CODE_TYPE = RTRIM(LTRIM(?code_type)) AND CODE_ID = RTRIM(LTRIM(?code_id))

sql-service.name: wfm.info.inf040.init.sortkey
sql-service.query: update ms_codebook set sort_key = '' where code_type = ?code_type

sql-service.name: wfm.info.inf040.create.sortkey
sql-service.query: update ms_codebook a set sort_key = lpad((select count(*) from ms_codebook where code_type = a.code_type and code_id != '00' and code_id <= a.code_id), (select len(count(*)) from ms_codebook where code_type = a.code_type), '0') where code_type = ?code_type and code_id != '00'

sql-service.name: wfm.info.info040.product.mapping.ins
sql-service.query: -- IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ms_codebook WHERE CODE_TYPE = 'COM004' and CODE_ID = ?PROD_CD) UPDATE ms_codebook SET CODE_NAME=(select p.PROD_NM from ms_product p where PROD_CD = ?PROD_CD) -- insert당시 product에 없었을 경우 다시 update해줌. ,ETC1=?ISTP_CD ,ETC2=(select CODE_NAME from ms_codebook where CODE_TYPE='COM003' and CODE_ID = ?ISTP_CD) ,CHG_ID = ?REG_ID ,CHG_TIME = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') WHERE code_type='COM004' and CODE_ID = ?PROD_CD; -- ELSE IF @@ROWCOUNT=0 INSERT INTO ms_codebook(CODE_TYPE,CODE_ID,CODE_NAME,ETC1,ETC2,USE_YN,REG_ID,REG_TIME) values ('COM004', ?PROD_CD, (select p.PROD_NM from ms_product p where PROD_CD = ?PROD_CD), ?ISTP_CD, (select CODE_NAME from ms_codebook where CODE_TYPE='COM003' and CODE_ID = ?ISTP_CD), 'Y', ?REG_ID, FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss'));

sql-service.name: inf.inf070.getUsedCPU.sel
sql-service.query:
SELECT BB.DEVICE_ID, BB.DEVICE_DESC, AA.LAST_DATE, AA.OS_GU, ISNULL(AA.CPU_USED_RATE,0) CPU_USED_RATE, AA.CPU_LOAD_LINUX, AA.USER_CPU, AA.SYS_CPU, AA.IDLE_CPU, AA.NICE_CPU FROM ( SELECT A.DEVICE_ID, MAX(C.DEVICE_DESC) DEVICE_DESC, MAX(A.LAST_UPDATED) LAST_DATE, C.OS_GU, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN B.OID_NAME = 'hrProcessorLoad' THEN CONVERT(FLOAT,B.VALUE) END),1) CPU_USED_RATE, AVG(CASE WHEN B.OID_NAME = 'ssCpuIdle' THEN 100-CONVERT(decimal(10),B.VALUE) END) CPU_LOAD_LINUX, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OID_NAME = 'systemUserCPU' THEN B.VALUE END) USER_CPU, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OID_NAME = 'systemSysCPU' THEN B.VALUE END) SYS_CPU, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OID_NAME = 'systemIdleCPU' THEN B.VALUE END) IDLE_CPU, MAX(CASE WHEN B.OID_NAME = 'systemNiceCPU' THEN B.VALUE END) NICE_CPU FROM MS_MIB A,MS_RT_PROCESS B, MS_DEVICE C WHERE A.DEVICE_ID = B.DEVICE_ID AND B.DEVICE_ID = C.DEVICE_ID AND C.DEVICE_ID = A.DEVICE_ID AND A.OID_TYPE = 'M' AND A.OID_GROUP IN ('hrProcessorLoad', 'systemStats')
GROUP BY A.DEVICE_ID, C.OS_GU ) AA RIGHT OUTER JOIN ms_device BB ON AA.DEVICE_ID=BB.DEVICE_ID

sql-service.name: inf.inf070.getUsedMemory.sel
sql-service.query:
SELECT BB.DEVICE_ID, AA.MEM_REG_TIME, AA.MEM_REG_DATE, AA.STORAGE_USED, AA.STORAGE_SIZE, ISNULL(AA.MEMORY_USED_RATE ,0) MEMORY_USED_RATE FROM ( SELECT B.DEVICE_ID, REG_TIME AS MEM_REG_TIME, REG_DATE AS MEM_REG_DATE, ROUND(STORAGE_USED, 2) AS STORAGE_USED, ROUND(STORAGE_SIZE, 2) AS STORAGE_SIZE, IsNULL(HR_MEMORY_SIZE, 0 ) AS HR_MEMORY_SIZE, ISNULL(round((convert(float,STORAGE_USED)/convert(float,STORAGE_SIZE)*100),1),0) MEMORY_USED_RATE FROM ( SELECT DEVICE_ID, format(A.LAST_UPDATED,'%H:%I') AS REG_TIME, format(A.LAST_UPDATED,'%Y-%m-%d') AS REG_DATE, (A.STORAGE_USED - BUFFERS_USED - A.CACHED_USED) AS STORAGE_USED, A.STORAGE_SIZE AS STORAGE_SIZE, CASE WHEN A.STORAGE_SIZE = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((A.STORAGE_USED - A.BUFFERS_USED - A.CACHED_USED) / A.STORAGE_SIZE) * 100, 2) END HR_MEMORY_SIZE FROM ( SELECT A.device_id AS DEVICE_ID, MAX(A.LAST_UPDATED) AS LAST_UPDATED, MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(B.STORAGE_DESCR) IN ('PHYSICAL MEMORY', 'SYSTEM RAM') THEN B.STORAGE_USED ELSE 0 END) AS STORAGE_USED, MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(B.STORAGE_DESCR) IN ('PHYSICAL MEMORY', 'SYSTEM RAM') THEN B.STORAGE_SIZE ELSE 0 END) AS STORAGE_SIZE, MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(B.STORAGE_DESCR) = ('MEMORY BUFFERS') THEN B.STORAGE_USED ELSE 0 END) AS BUFFERS_USED, MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(B.STORAGE_DESCR) = ('CACHED MEMORY') THEN B.STORAGE_USED ELSE 0 END) AS CACHED_USED FROM MS_MIB A, MS_RT_USAGE B WHERE A.DEVICE_ID = B.DEVICE_ID AND A.OID_TYPE = 'M' AND A.OID_GROUP = 'Usage'
AND UPPER(B.STORAGE_DESCR) IN ('PHYSICAL MEMORY', 'MEMORY BUFFERS', 'CACHED MEMORY', 'SYSTEM RAM') GROUP BY A.device_id, A.DEVICE_ID ) A ) B ) AA RIGHT OUTER JOIN ms_device BB ON AA.DEVICE_ID=BB.DEVICE_ID

sql-service.name: inf.inf070.getUsedDisk.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT BB.DEVICE_ID, BB.DEVICE_DESC, AA.DISK_REG_TIME, AA.DISK_REG_DATE, ISNULL(AA.DISK_USED_RATE,0) DISK_USED_RATE FROM ( SELECT A.DEVICE_ID, format(A.LAST_UPDATED,'%H:%I') AS DISK_REG_TIME, format(A.LAST_UPDATED,'%Y-%m-%d') AS DISK_REG_DATE, CASE WHEN AVG(CONVERT(FLOAT,B.STORAGE_SIZE)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(AVG(CONVERT(FLOAT,B.STORAGE_USED)) / AVG(CONVERT(FLOAT,B.STORAGE_SIZE)) * 100, 1) END DISK_USED_RATE FROM MS_MIB A, MS_RT_USAGE B WHERE A.DEVICE_ID = B.DEVICE_ID AND A.OID_TYPE = 'M' AND A.OID_GROUP = 'Usage' GROUP BY A.device_id, A.LAST_UPDATED ) AA RIGHT OUTER JOIN ms_device BB ON AA.DEVICE_ID=BB.DEVICE_ID

(등급부여)' END ) REASON FROM ms_stt_meta S, ms_usermaster B WHERE S.USER_ID=B.USER_ID AND REG_DATE BETWEEN FORMAT(DATEADD(M, -3, GETDATE()), 'yyyyMMdd') AND FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') AND GRD_FLAG='E' ORDER BY CON_ENT_DGN_DATE DESC

sql-service.query: SELECT FILEID --,format(CONVERT(DATE,REC_START_TIME),'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') REC_START_TIME ,format(convert(date,substring(REC_START_TIME,1,8)),'yyyy-MM-dd') + ' '+ substring(REC_START_TIME,9,2) + ':' + substring(REC_START_TIME,11,2) + ':' +substring(REC_START_TIME,13,2) REC_START_TIME ,ORGFILEFULLPATH ,ORGFILENAME ,ISNULL((SELECT USER_NAME FROM ms_usermaster WHERE USER_ID = A.REQ_ID) + '(' +REQ_ID + ')',REQ_ID) AS REQ_ID ,CASE WHEN STT_FLAG = 'S' THEN '작업중' WHEN STT_FLAG = 'Y' THEN '작업완료' WHEN STT_FLAG = 'E' THEN '작업오류' WHEN STT_FLAG = 'N' THEN '작업대상' END STT_FLAG_NM ,STT_FLAG --,format(CONVERT(DATE,STT_R_TIME),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') STT_R_TIME ,STT_R_TIME ,STT_ERR_CD ,BATCH_YN ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM ms_usermaster WHERE USER_ID = A.REG_ID) + '(' +REG_ID + ')' AS REG_ID ,format(convert(date,substring(REG_DATE,1,8)),'yyyy-MM-dd') + ' '+ substring(REG_DATE,9,2) + ':' + substring(REG_DATE,11,2) + ':' +substring(REG_DATE,13,2) REG_DATE FROM ms_rec_batch A WHERE 1=1 AND REC_START_TIME BETWEEN ?searchRecStartDateFrom +'000000' AND ?searchRecStartDateTo +'235959' AND REG_DATE BETWEEN ?searchRegDateFrom +'000000' AND ?searchRegDateTo +'235959' ?searchReqId ?searchOrgFileNm ?searchChkSttFlag ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC

sql-service.query: SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM MS_REC_BATCH WHERE REG_DATE BETWEEN FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') +'0900' AND FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd')+'2000'
